title: astrocyte research graph (OpenAlex)
description: The 500 most-cited works on astrocytes (the star-shaped glial cells of the brain) from OpenAlex (CC0), as a connected citation core: 4,113 cito:cites edges linking 500 papers to 2,074 authors, 537 institutions and 875 sub-topics. Explore the most-cited papers, the most prolific labs, and which fields astrocyte research bridges (reactive astrocytes, blood-brain barrier, neuroinflammation, stem cells).
example_queries: SELECT ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } GROUP BY ?p ORDER BY DESC(?n)

PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ex: <http://ex/>
SELECT ?title ?c WHERE { ?w a ex:Work ; dct:title ?title ; ex:citationCount ?c } ORDER BY DESC(?c) LIMIT 15

PREFIX ex: <http://ex/>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
SELECT ?name (COUNT(?w) AS ?papers) WHERE { ?w ex:author ?a . ?a foaf:name ?name } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?papers) LIMIT 15

PREFIX ex: <http://ex/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?inst (COUNT(DISTINCT ?w) AS ?papers) WHERE { ?w ex:author ?a . ?a ex:affiliation ?i . ?i rdfs:label ?inst } GROUP BY ?inst ORDER BY DESC(?papers) LIMIT 15

PREFIX ex: <http://ex/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?topic (COUNT(?w) AS ?papers) WHERE { ?w ex:topic ?t . ?t rdfs:label ?topic } GROUP BY ?topic ORDER BY DESC(?papers) LIMIT 20

PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ex: <http://ex/>
SELECT ?title ?year WHERE { ?citing cito:cites <https://openalex.org/W2572710398> ; dct:title ?title ; ex:year ?year } ORDER BY DESC(?year) LIMIT 50
